changes: Added built-in secret redaction to prevent credentials, tokens, and keys from leaking in logs.
Added recursive masking for dictionaries, lists, request data, and response data.
Added pattern-based masking for raw log strings, DB URLs, and Authorization headers.
Logs are now redacted before storage and before UI display for defense-in-depth safety.
Added configuration options for custom sensitive keys and redaction mask.
Latest logs are now shown first by default (reverse chronological order).
Added beautiful UI badges for log levels to improve readability.
Timestamps converted to readable relative times (e.g. '2 minutes ago') with exact time on hover.
Enhanced overall UI aesthetics with animations, shadow effects, and a premium feel.
Initial stable release with dynamic UI and real-time log tailing.
Search, filter, and pagination capabilities added.
